Filmmaker Aditya Dhar Defends Actor Yash Amid Online Criticism

Filmmaker Aditya Dhar has publicly supported actor Yash following a period of online criticism directed at the actor. Dhar's statement of support has generated positive reactions from fans, with many expressing a desire for the two to collaborate on a future project. The specific nature of the criticism against Yash was not detailed in the coverage.
